summary: Shared inbox and customer operations platform for email, SMS and chat conversations.
access_note: API tokens created by an admin in Settings > Developers; public integrations must use OAuth. No free plan seen, trial only.
blocker_note: Needs a paid/trial Front workspace; public integrations must use OAuth and the MCP server needs a confidential OAuth app created in Front developer settings.
notes: Older page at /docs/mcp marks the previous MCP version as deprecated; use /docs/mcp-server. Quote for MCP and auth taken from raw .md versions of the pages.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to get a Bearer token — through API tokens in your settings or through an OAuth implementation
The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.
Front's MCP server (`mcp.frontapp.com/mcp`) lets AI agents act on Front conversation data using a single OAuth-authenticated endpoint.
